details.flavorMarkdown: *A gaunt, corpse-eating undead with stretched lips, long nails and flesh drawn tight over its joints. It retains enough cunning to seek an isolated victim and avoid a determined group.*

details.generalMarkdown:
### General details

**Basic Melee:** One adjacent creature; physical damage; Agility defense. Uses the printed Threat. No specialty riders.

**Defend:** Player attacks suffer 1 additional Bane until the start of its next turn. Combines with Evasion through normal Boon/Bane rules. Repeated Defend does not stack.

**Opportunity Attack:** Basic Melee against the provoking creature. Spends its Reaction before the provoking action resolves. That action continues if the creature remains capable.

**Lifeless Body:** does not breathe or eat; only the listed immunities apply.

**Healing:** Healing-harmed: ordinary healing resolves as Life damage instead; no beneficial riders.

**Against offensive healing:** controller defends with Fortitude if this is player-controlled; a player attacking it still rolls only their attack.

**Senses:** Ordinary sight and hearing.

**Signs:** Bones are cracked for marrow and stacked with unnatural care.

**Purpose:** Feed without returning to the grave.

**Tactics and retreat:** Strike with Grave Chill, then rake on the intervening turn; avoid concentrated light and numbers.

**Counterplay and conversation:** Keep a rescuer beside the front line and deny isolated feeding targets.

**Habitat:** Crypt; battlefield · **Communication:** None

**Loot:** The latest victim’s recoverable pack.

**Summoning:** Undead 3 — [player reference](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/9bc9b4fe3256e68880b92c45facf0f25b98a1ea3/design/bestiary/summons/crypt-ghoul.md).

## Design notes — not needed during play

**ID:** creature-crypt-ghoul


**Category:** Undead · **Role:** Disabler · **CV:** 17

**Difficulty rationale:** An agile or elusive body warrants attack Banes. Its dangerous attack imposes defense Banes.

**Reference damage:** 3/4/6

**Reference type:** physical

**Expected targets:** 1

**Utility factor:** 1.45

**Regeneration per turn:** 0

Reference I=4.404, O=3.653. CV uses the [seed worksheet](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/9bc9b4fe3256e68880b92c45facf0f25b98a1ea3/design/bestiary/encounters.md); action choices, Stability and control are not simulated. Recalibration remains required.

**Ability sources:** [grave chill](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/9bc9b4fe3256e68880b92c45facf0f25b98a1ea3/design/monster-abilities/grave-chill.md), [lifeless body](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/9bc9b4fe3256e68880b92c45facf0f25b98a1ea3/design/monster-abilities/lifeless-body.md), [rending blow](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/9bc9b4fe3256e68880b92c45facf0f25b98a1ea3/design/monster-abilities/rending-blow.md).
